Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A 15.00-second, 16:9, single-take, live-action cinematic photorealistic vision of a monumental Eastern celestial palace above a sea of clouds. The composition follows the monumental celestial palace layout, scale and atmosphere established by <Picture 1>, with towering architectural elements and a grand clean terrace.

A solitary figure in a long vivid-red robe walks slowly forward between the columns. The figure remains extremely small, occupying only about 2% of the frame height, a restrained red point surrounded by open architecture. Maintain an empty radius around the figure measuring more than ten times the figure’s height; no other people, statues, furniture, or decorative objects interrupt the repeating rhythm of the columns. The figure’s body and gait remain quiet and composed. Long hair and the trailing robe respond together to the same gentle high-altitude wind, drifting softly backward without exaggerated fluttering.

Through the gaps between the columns, a colossal distant ceremonial gate appears in silhouette, illuminated from behind by low celestial light. Farther beyond it, successive tiers of Eastern palace roofs and halls become progressively smaller along the edge of the cloud sea. Atmospheric perspective makes the nearest structures solid and detailed while each distant layer becomes paler, softer, and less distinct. The lowest 30% of the composition contains a low sea of clouds: nearby cloud masses have clear sculptural volume and slowly rolling edges, while distant clouds merge into a calm, continuous white plain.

From 00:00.000 to 00:05.000, the very wide establishing composition holds the seven-column rhythm, the tiny red-robed figure, the clean marble terrace, and the cloud sea simultaneously. High diffuse light falls evenly from the upper right, creating warm, smooth highlights on the pearl-gray stone and bright, translucent shadows with gentle contrast. The camera begins an extremely slow Push In at slow speed while performing a very shallow Arc Shot with small amplitude around the figure’s path. The movement remains stabilized and nearly imperceptible, preserving the wide monumental scale and the upper-right vanishing point.

From 00:05.000 to 00:10.000, the same uninterrupted camera motion creates restrained parallax between the immense foreground columns. The figure completes several slow, measured steps without approaching enough to become visually prominent, remaining approximately 2% of frame height. Soft reflections of the red robe and column bases shift subtly across the spotless marble. The robe hem and long hair continue streaming backward in the same wind direction. The cloud banks roll and drift slowly beneath the terrace while the distant gate remains framed through one column gap.

From 00:10.000 to 00:15.000, the camera continues its slow forward movement and shallow arc without rising, shaking, zooming rapidly, or cutting. Slightly changing gaps between the columns reveal additional receding palace layers along the cloud edge, while atmospheric haze preserves a clear near-solid, far-soft depth hierarchy. The seven columns retain their exact number, monumental width, pearl-gray material, star-trail reliefs, and converging arrangement. End on a balanced wide composition in which the tiny moving red figure remains overwhelmed by the celestial architecture and surrounding emptiness. No additional characters, birds, flying vehicles, text, subtitles, dirt, debris, dramatic weather, flickering light, column deformation, changing column count, rapid cloud turbulence, exaggerated cloth motion, camera shake, fast orbit, cuts, or abrupt depth-of-field changes.

overall_soundscape: A soft continuous high-altitude wind moves through the enormous column gaps, producing a low spacious resonance. The tiny figure’s measured footsteps create faint, widely spaced taps on the marble, accompanied by delicate robe and hair movement; the distant cloud sea remains nearly silent.

non_diegetic_music: Widely spaced, breathy xiao flute tones drift over faint high-register bowed-glass harmonics and a nearly inaudible low string drone, moving at an extremely slow tempo with long reverberant decay. The music remains sparse and quieter than the wind and footsteps, contains no percussion or rhythmic pulse, and gradually fades toward near-silence during the final seconds.
